title: Bank Apps Down: Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland Outage Reported
description: Reports indicate that Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland apps are down, leaving thousands unable to access accounts according to GB News.

sections.heading: Reported Service Disruptions
paragraphs: According to The Telegraph, the apps for Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland are down. The Daily Express also reported that the banking app is down, noting that Halifax and Bank of Scotland are also affected.

sections.heading: Customer Impact
paragraphs: GB News reported that the Lloyds banking app outage left thousands of customers unable to access their accounts.

faq.q: Which banking apps are reported to be down?
faq.a: According to The Telegraph and the Daily Express, the apps for Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland are down.

faq.q: How are customers affected by the outage?
faq.a: GB News reports that the outage left thousands of customers unable to access their accounts.
